nodes.name: build_labels.py
nodes.body_text: """Merge labels into cases.jsonl with provenance. Cases 1-4 come from the human (parsed from LABEL_ME.md, kept verbatim in label_user). Cases 5-15 were labelled by Claude from the record text only (label_by = "claude"). Cases 1-3: the human's funding_type "social_investment" is overridden to "project" because those are plain grants (the sheet defines social_investment as an investment or loan); the original is kept in label_user and the change is recorded in label_note. """ import json import re from pathlib import Path HERE = Path(__file__).parent KEYS = ["theme", "beneficiary", "funding_type", "outcome_stated", "impact_case_score"] CLAUDE = { # id -> (theme, beneficiary, funding_type, outcome_stated, score) 5: ("other", "unclear", "core_costs", False, 1), 6: ("arts_culture", "ethnic_minority_communities", "core_costs", False, 2), 7: ("community_places", "general_community", "project", True, 3), 8: ("health_wellbeing", "people_in_poverty", "project", True, 4), 9: ("other", "unclear", "core_costs", False, 1), 10: ("energy_environment", "unclear", "project", False, 1), 11: ("other", "organisations_sector", "project", False, 1), 12: ("other", "children_young_people", "project", False, 2), 13: ("community_places", "unclear", "other", False, 1), 14: ("community_places", "unclear", "other", False, 1), 15: ("other", "unclear", "project", False, 1), } user_lines = [l for l in (HERE / "LABEL_ME.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if l.startswith("LABEL:")] user = {i + 1: parse(l) for i, l in enumerate(user_lines) if "?" not in l} cases = [json.loads(l) for l in open(HERE / "cases.jsonl", encoding="utf-8")] for c in cases: i = c["id"] notes = [] if i in user: c["label_user"] = user[i] c["label"] = dict(user[i]) c["label_by"] = "user" if user[i]["funding_type"] == "social_investment" and i <= 3: c["label"]["funding_type"] = "project" notes.append("funding_type social_investment -> project (plain grant, not an investment/loan)") if i == 4: notes.append("user scored outcome_stated=true/4 but the text states no outcome; kept as the user labelled it") else: c["label"] = dict(zip(KEYS, CLAUDE[i])) c["label_by"] = "claude" c["label_note"] = "; ".join(notes) with open(HERE / "cases.jsonl", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: for c in cases: f.write(json.dumps(c, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n") print({c["id"]: c["label_by"] for c in cases}) print("score dist:", sorted(c["label"]["impact_case_score"] for c in cases))

nodes.name: parse
nodes.body_text: def parse(line: str) -> dict: t, b, f, o, s = [p.strip() for p in line.split(":", 1)[1].split("|")] return dict(zip(KEYS, [t, b, f, o.lower() == "true", int(s)]))

run_eval.py
nodes.body_text: """Run the impact-screen skill over eval/cases.jsonl and score it. python eval/run_eval.py --skill skills/impact_screen/SKILL_v1.md --tag v1 Scores: * exact match per field (theme, beneficiary, funding_type, outcome_stated) * impact_case_score: exact, within +/-1, mean absolute error * evidence quotes that are verbatim in the record (deterministic) * groundedness judged by a DIFFERENT model than the one that ran the skill * judge sanity check: the judge must catch planted fabrications and not flag clean outputs Writes eval/results/<tag>.json and prints a summary. """ import argparse import json import os import random import re import time from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor from pathlib import Path from dotenv import load_dotenv from openai import OpenAI, RateLimitError HERE = Path(__file__).parent ROOT = HERE.parent load_dotenv(ROOT / ".env") FIELDS = ["theme", "beneficiary", "funding_type", "outcome_stated"] client = OpenAI(base_url="https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1", api_key=os.environ["NVIDIA_API_KEY"], timeout=180, max_retries=1) # Listed-but-404 on this account: nemotron-3-super, kimi-k2.6, mistral-large. These two answered in a probe. SKILL_MODEL = "nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b" JUDGE_MODEL = "minimaxai/minimax-m3.1-flash" JUDGE_SYSTEM = """You check an automated impact screen of a grant record for unsupported claims. You get the RECORD and the SCREEN OUTPUT. List every statement in the output's "impact" fields (what, who, how_much, contribution, risk) that asserts a fact, number, place, group or outcome that is NOT in the record. "not stated" and cautious wording are fine. Reasonable restatement of the record is fine. Reply with JSON only: {"unsupported": ["..."], "grounded": true|false} where grounded is false if and only if the list is non-empty.""" if __name__ == "__main__": main()

nodes.name: chat
nodes.signature: def chat(model: str, system: str, user: str, max_tokens: int = 1500) -> str
nodes.body_text: def chat(model: str, system: str, user: str, max_tokens: int = 1500) -> str: for attempt in range(6): # NIM's free tier rate-limits (429): back off and retry try: r = client.chat.completions.create( model=model, messages=[{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}], temperature=0, max_tokens=max_tokens, ) return r.choices[0].message.content or "" except RateLimitError: time.sleep(5 * 2**attempt) raise RuntimeError(f"{model}: still rate-limited after retries")

nodes.name: parse_json
nodes.body_text: def parse_json(text: str) -> dict | None: text = re.sub(r"<think>.*?</think>", "", text, flags=re.S) m = re.search(r"\{.*\}", text, flags=re.S) if not m: return None try: return json.loads(m.group(0)) except json.JSONDecodeError: return None

nodes.name: record_text
norm
nodes.body_text: def norm(s: str) -> str: return re.sub(r"\W+", " ", s.lower()).strip()

nodes.signature: def judge(model: str, c: dict, out: dict) -> dict

nodes.name: run_case
nodes.signature: def run_case(c: dict, skill: str, model: str) -> dict: # Validate and retry: the model occasionally truncates or loops. Retries are reported, not hidden.
nodes.body_text: def run_case(c: dict, skill: str, model: str) -> dict: # Validate and retry: the model occasionally truncates or loops. Retries are reported, not hidden. for retries in range(3): raw = chat(model, skill, "Screen this record.\n\n" + record_text(c)) out = parse_json(raw) if out and all(k in out for k in ("theme", "beneficiary", "funding_type", "outcome_stated", "impact_case_score")): return {"id": c["id"], "raw": raw, "out": out, "retries": retries} return {"id": c["id"], "raw": raw, "out": None, "retries": retries}

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: def main() -> None: ap = argparse.ArgumentParser() ap.add_argument("--skill", required=True) ap.add_argument("--tag", required=True) ap.add_argument("--model", default=SKILL_MODEL) ap.add_argument("--judge-model", default=JUDGE_MODEL) a = ap.parse_args() skill = re.sub(r"\A---.*?---\s*", "", Path(a.skill).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), flags=re.S) cases = [json.loads(l) for l in open(HERE / "cases.jsonl", encoding="utf-8")] by_id = {c["id"]: c for c in cases} cache = HERE / "results" / f"{a.tag}_raw.json" # skill outputs are cached so a judge failure doesn't redo them (HERE / "results").mkdir(exist_ok=True) if cache.exists(): runs = json.loads(cache.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) else: with ThreadPoolExecutor(4) as pool: runs = list(pool.map(lambda c: run_case(c, skill, a.model), cases)) cache.write_text(json.dumps(runs, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8") rows, planted = [], [] random.seed(0) for r in runs: c, out = by_id[r["id"]], r["out"] row = {"id": c["id"], "label_by": c["label_by"], "valid_json": out is not None} if out: lab = c["label"] for f in FIELDS: row[f] = out.get(f) == lab[f] s = out.get("impact_case_score") row["pred_score"], row["true_score"] = s, lab["impact_case_score"] row["score_exact"] = s == lab["impact_case_score"] row["score_within1"] = isinstance(s, int) and abs(s - lab["impact_case_score"]) <= 1 quotes = out.get("evidence_quotes") or [] hay = norm(record_text(c)) row["quotes_total"] = len(quotes) row["quotes_verbatim"] = sum(norm(q) in hay for q in quotes) row["pred"] = {f: out.get(f) for f in FIELDS} row["true"] = {f: lab[f] for f in FIELDS} rows.append(row) # Judge: clean outputs (+ planted fabrications on 4 of them) valid = [r for r in runs if r["out"]] plant_ids = {r["id"] for r in random.sample(valid, min(4, len(valid)))} fabrications = [ "serves 5,000 refugees across Yorkshire each year", "has reduced reoffending by 40% according to an independent evaluation", "is a partnership with the NHS covering 12 hospitals", "was matched by a GBP 2m government grant", ] jobs = [] for r in valid: out = json.loads(json.dumps(r["out"])) is_planted = r["id"] in plant_ids if is_planted: out.setdefault("impact", {})["how_much"] = "The programme " + fabrications[len(planted) % 4] planted.append(r["id"]) jobs.append((r["id"], is_planted, out)) with ThreadPoolExecutor(2) as pool: verdicts = list(pool.map(lambda j: judge(a.judge_model, by_id[j[0]], j[2]), jobs)) judged = [{"id": j[0], "planted": j[1], "grounded": v.get("grounded"), "unsupported": v.get("unsupported")} for j, v in zip(jobs, verdicts)] for row in rows: for j in judged: if j["id"] == row["id"] and not j["planted"]: row["judge_grounded"] = j["grounded"] row["judge_unsupported"] = j["unsupported"] n = len(rows) ok = [r for r in rows if r["valid_json"]] pct = lambda k, rs=ok: round(100 * sum(bool(r[k]) for r in rs) / max(len(rs), 1)) qt = sum(r["quotes_total"] for r in ok) clean = [j for j in judged if not j["planted"]] plant = [j for j in judged if j["planted"]] summary = { "tag": a.tag, "skill": a.skill, "model": a.model, "judge_model": a.judge_model, "n": n, "valid_json_pct": round(100 * len(ok) / n), "cases_needing_retry": sum(r.get("retries", 0) > 0 for r in runs), **{f"{f}_pct": pct(f) for f in FIELDS}, "score_exact_pct": pct("score_exact"), "score_within1_pct": pct("score_within1"), "score_mae": round(sum(abs(r["pred_score"] - r["true_score"]) for r in ok if isinstance(r["pred_score"], int)) / max(len(ok), 1), 2), "quotes_verbatim_pct": round(100 * sum(r["quotes_verbatim"] for r in ok) / max(qt, 1)), "judge_grounded_clean": f"{sum(j['grounded'] is True for j in clean)}/{len([j for j in clean if j['grounded'] is not None])}", "judge_errors": sum(j["grounded"] is None for j in judged), "judge_caught_planted": f"{sum(j['grounded'] is False for j in plant)}/{len(plant)}", "by_label_author": { who: {"n": len([r for r in ok if r["label_by"] == who]), "fields_exact_pct": round(100 * sum(r[f] for r in ok if r["label_by"] == who for f in FIELDS) / max(4 * len([r for r in ok if r["label_by"] == who]), 1))} for who in ("user", "claude") }, } (HERE / "results").mkdir(exist_ok=True) (HERE / "results" / f"{a.tag}.json").write_text( json.dumps({"summary": summary, "rows": rows, "judge": judged, "raw": {r["id"]: r["raw"] for r in runs}}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8", ) print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2)) for row in rows: if row["valid_json"]: bad = [f for f in FIELDS if not row[f]] print(f"#{row['id']:>2} pred_score={row['pred_score']} true={row['true_score']} wrong_fields={bad}") else: print(f"#{row['id']:>2} INVALID JSON")

nodes.name: sample_cases.py
fetch_data.py
nodes.body_text: """Download a few 360Giving funder files and load them into one SQLite table. The 360Giving registry (https://registry.threesixtygiving.org/data.json) lists every publisher's file. We pick a handful of funders close to social-impact work, normalise the two shapes we meet (360Giving xlsx/csv with "Recipient Org:Name"-style headers, and the JSON grants array) and write data/grants.sqlite for server.py to query. Run: python fetch_data.py """ import io import json import re import sqlite3 from pathlib import Path import httpx import pandas as pd HERE = Path(__file__).parent RAW = HERE / "data" / "raw" DB = HERE / "data" / "grants.sqlite" REGISTRY = "https://registry.threesixtygiving.org/data.json" # (publisher substring, title substring) -> one dataset each WANTED = [ ("Esm", "grants and social investments"), ("Power to Change", "Grants awarded since 2015"), ("Lloyds Bank Foundation", "Grants awarded from 2010"), ("Barrow Cadbury", "Grants awarded since April 2012"), ("Nesta", "Nesta grants awarded"), ] # 360Giving column name (lower-cased, spaces stripped) -> our column COLS = { "identifier": "grant_id", "title": "title", "description": "description", "amountawarded": "amount", "awarddate": "award_date", "recipientorg:identifier": "recipient_id", "recipientorg:name": "recipient", "fundingorg:name": "funder", "beneficiarylocation:name": "location", "grantprogramme:title": "programme", } if __name__ == "__main__": main()

nodes.name: pick_datasets
nodes.body_text: def pick_datasets(registry: list[dict]) -> list[dict]: chosen = [] for pub, title in WANTED: for ds in registry: if pub in ds["publisher"]["name"] and title.lower() in ds["title"].lower(): chosen.append(ds) break else: print(f"!! not in registry: {pub} / {title}") return chosen

nodes.name: from_json
nodes.signature: def from_json(payload: dict, funder: str) -> pd.DataFrame
nodes.body_text: def from_json(payload: dict, funder: str) -> pd.DataFrame: rows = [] for g in payload.get("grants", []): recip = (g.get("recipientOrganization") or [{}])[0] loc = (g.get("beneficiaryLocation") or [{}])[0] prog = g.get("grantProgramme") or [{}] rows.append( { "grant_id": g.get("id"), "title": g.get("title"), "description": g.get("description"), "amount": g.get("amountAwarded"), "award_date": g.get("awardDate"), "recipient_id": recip.get("id"), "recipient": recip.get("name"), "funder": ((g.get("fundingOrganization") or [{}])[0]).get("name") or funder, "location": loc.get("name"), "programme": prog[0].get("title"), } ) return pd.DataFrame(rows)

nodes.name: from_sheet
nodes.signature: def from_sheet(content: bytes, url: str, funder: str) -> pd.DataFrame
nodes.body_text: def from_sheet(content: bytes, url: str, funder: str) -> pd.DataFrame: if re.search(r"\.csv", url, re.I): sheets = {"csv": pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(content), dtype=str)} else: sheets = pd.read_excel(io.BytesIO(content), sheet_name=None, dtype=str) best = pd.DataFrame() for df in sheets.values(): df = df.rename(columns=lambda c: re.sub(r"\s+", "", str(c)).lower()) df = df.rename(columns={k: v for k, v in COLS.items() if k in df.columns}) if "amount" in df.columns and "title" in df.columns and len(df) > len(best): best = df for c in COLS.values(): if c not in best.columns: best[c] = None best["funder"] = best["funder"].fillna(funder) return best[list(COLS.values())]

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: def main() -> None: RAW.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with httpx.Client(follow_redirects=True, timeout=120, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"}) as http: registry = http.get(REGISTRY).json() frames = [] for ds in pick_datasets(registry): funder = ds["publisher"]["name"] url = ds["distribution"][0]["downloadURL"] print(f"{funder}: {url}") resp = http.get(url) resp.raise_for_status() (RAW / re.sub(r"\W+", "_", funder)).with_suffix(".bin").write_bytes(resp.content) if "json" in resp.headers.get("content-type", "") or resp.content[:1] in (b"{", b"["): df = from_json(json.loads(resp.content), funder) else: df = from_sheet(resp.content, url, funder) df["amount"] = pd.to_numeric(df["amount"], errors="coerce") df["award_date"] = df["award_date"].astype(str).str[:10] print(f" {len(df)} grants, {df['amount'].notna().sum()} with amounts") frames.append(df) grants = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True) grants["funder"] = grants["funder"].str.replace(r"^Esm.e ", "Esmée ", regex=True) # registry mangles the accent with sqlite3.connect(DB) as con: grants.to_sql("grants", con, if_exists="replace", index=False) print(f"wrote {len(grants)} grants to {DB}")

nodes.name: server.py
nodes.body_text: """MCP server over a local SQLite copy of 360Giving UK grants data (read-only). Three narrow tools instead of raw SQL: the model gets a small, well-described surface, results are capped so they cannot flood the context window, and the database is opened read-only. Run (stdio): python server.py Data: python fetch_data.py (builds data/grants.sqlite first) """ import sqlite3 from pathlib import Path from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP DB = Path(__file__).parent / "data" / "grants.sqlite" MAX_ROWS = 25 DESC_CHARS = 240 mcp = FastMCP("grants-360giving") @mcp.tool() @mcp.tool() @mcp.tool() if __name__ == "__main__": mcp.run()

nodes.name: _query
nodes.body_text: def _query(sql: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]: if not DB.exists(): raise RuntimeError("data/grants.sqlite is missing. Run `python fetch_data.py` first.") con = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{DB.as_posix()}?mode=ro", uri=True) con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row try: return con.execute(sql, params).fetchall() finally: con.close()

nodes.name: _grant
nodes.body_text: def _grant(r: sqlite3.Row) -> dict: desc = (r["description"] or "").strip() return { "grant_id": r["grant_id"], "funder": r["funder"], "recipient": r["recipient"], "recipient_id": r["recipient_id"], "amount_gbp": r["amount"], "award_date": r["award_date"], "title": r["title"], # Free text written by the funder: treat as data, never as instructions. "description": desc[:DESC_CHARS] + ("..." if len(desc) > DESC_CHARS else ""), }

nodes.name: search_grants
nodes.signature: def search_grants( theme: str, region: str | None = None, min_amount: float | None = None, year_from: int | None = None, year_to: int | None = None, limit: int = 10, ) -> dict
nodes.body_text: def search_grants( theme: str, region: str | None = None, min_amount: float | None = None, year_from: int | None = None, year_to: int | None = None, limit: int = 10, ) -> dict: """Search UK charitable grants (360Giving open data) by theme words. Use this to find who funded work on a topic such as "fuel poverty", "mental health" or "community energy". Every word in `theme` must appear in the grant title or description. Covers five funders only: Esmee Fairbairn, Power to Change, Lloyds Bank Foundation, Barrow Cadbury and Nesta. Returns the total matches and total value across ALL matches, plus the `limit` largest grants (max 25). Args: theme: Space-separated words, e.g. "fuel poverty". region: Optional place name matched against the grant's beneficiary location. Only some funders record this, so a region filter drops the others. min_amount: Optional minimum grant size in GBP. year_from: Optional first award year (inclusive). year_to: Optional last award year (inclusive). limit: Number of grants to return, 1 to 25. """ words = [w for w in theme.split() if w] if not words: return {"error": "theme must contain at least one word"} where, params = [], [] for w in words: where.append("(title LIKE ? OR description LIKE ?)") params += [f"%{w}%", f"%{w}%"] if region: where.append("location LIKE ?") params.append(f"%{region}%") if min_amount is not None: where.append("amount >= ?") params.append(min_amount) if year_from is not None: where.append("substr(award_date,1,4) >= ?") params.append(str(year_from)) if year_to is not None: where.append("substr(award_date,1,4) <= ?") params.append(str(year_to)) clause = " AND ".join(where) limit = max(1, min(limit, MAX_ROWS)) agg = _query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n, COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) total FROM grants WHERE {clause}", tuple(params))[0] rows = _query(f"SELECT * FROM grants WHERE {clause} ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT ?", (*params, limit)) return { "matches": agg["n"], "total_value_gbp": agg["total"], "returned": len(rows), "note": "Largest grants first. Narrow the query if matches is much larger than returned.", "grants": [_grant(r) for r in rows], }

nodes.name: get_funder_summary
nodes.body_text: def get_funder_summary(funder: str) -> dict: """Summarise one funder's grant-making in this dataset. Returns number of grants, total and mean size, award-year range, grants and value per year, and the five largest recipients by total value. Use it to understand a funder's scale and focus before looking at individual grants. Args: funder: Part of the funder name, e.g. "Esmee", "Nesta", "Lloyds". """ like = f"%{funder}%" names = _query("SELECT DISTINCT funder FROM grants WHERE funder LIKE ?", (like,)) if not names: known = [r["funder"] for r in _query("SELECT DISTINCT funder FROM grants")] return {"error": f"no funder matches '{funder}'", "known_funders": known} if len(names) > 1: return {"error": "ambiguous funder name", "candidates": [r["funder"] for r in names]} name = names[0]["funder"] base = _query( "SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(amount) total, AVG(amount) mean, MIN(award_date) first, MAX(award_date) last " "FROM grants WHERE funder = ?", (name,), )[0] by_year = _query( "SELECT substr(award_date,1,4) yr, COUNT(*) n, SUM(amount) total FROM grants " "WHERE funder = ? GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr", (name,), ) top = _query( "SELECT recipient, recipient_id, COUNT(*) n, SUM(amount) total FROM grants " "WHERE funder = ? GROUP BY recipient_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5", (name,), ) return { "funder": name, "grants": base["n"], "total_value_gbp": base["total"], "mean_grant_gbp": round(base["mean"] or 0), "first_award": base["first"], "last_award": base["last"], "per_year": [{"year": r["yr"], "grants": r["n"], "value_gbp": r["total"]} for r in by_year], "top_recipients": [ {"recipient": r["recipient"], "recipient_id": r["recipient_id"], "grants": r["n"], "value_gbp": r["total"]} for r in top ], }

nodes.name: get_recipient
nodes.signature: def get_recipient(name_or_id: str, limit: int = 10) -> dict
nodes.body_text: def get_recipient(name_or_id: str, limit: int = 10) -> dict: """Look up an organisation's grants across all funders in the dataset. Pass a charity/company identifier such as "GB-CHC-1135192" for an exact match, or part of the organisation's name. Returns totals per funder and the most recent grants. If several different organisations match a name, returns them for you to choose from. Args: name_or_id: Org identifier (GB-CHC-..., GB-COH-...) or part of its name. limit: Number of recent grants to return, 1 to 25. """ limit = max(1, min(limit, MAX_ROWS)) if name_or_id.upper().startswith("GB-"): where, params = "recipient_id = ?", (name_or_id.upper(),) else: where, params = "recipient LIKE ?", (f"%{name_or_id}%",) orgs = _query( f"SELECT recipient_id, MIN(recipient) recipient, COUNT(*) n FROM grants WHERE {where} " "GROUP BY recipient_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 8", params, ) if not orgs: return {"error": f"no recipient matches '{name_or_id}'"} if len(orgs) > 1: return { "error": "several organisations match; call again with one recipient_id", "candidates": [{"recipient": o["recipient"], "recipient_id": o["recipient_id"], "grants": o["n"]} for o in orgs], } rid = orgs[0]["recipient_id"] by_funder = _query( "SELECT funder, COUNT(*) n, SUM(amount) total FROM grants WHERE recipient_id = ? GROUP BY funder ORDER BY total DESC", (rid,), ) recent = _query("SELECT * FROM grants WHERE recipient_id = ? ORDER BY award_date DESC LIMIT ?", (rid, limit)) return { "recipient": orgs[0]["recipient"], "recipient_id": rid, "total_grants": orgs[0]["n"], "total_value_gbp": sum(r["total"] or 0 for r in by_funder), "by_funder": [{"funder": r["funder"], "grants": r["n"], "value_gbp": r["total"]} for r in by_funder], "recent_grants": [_grant(r) for r in recent], }

nodes.name: smoke_test.py
nodes.body_text: """Start server.py over stdio like a real MCP client and call each tool once.""" import asyncio import json import sys from pathlib import Path from mcp import ClientSession, StdioServerParameters from mcp.client.stdio import stdio_client HERE = Path(__file__).parent asyncio.run(main())

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: async def main() -> None: params = StdioServerParameters(command=sys.executable, args=[str(HERE / "server.py")]) async with stdio_client(params) as (read, write): async with ClientSession(read, write) as session: await session.initialize() tools = await session.list_tools() print("tools:", [t.name for t in tools.tools]) calls = [ ("search_grants", {"theme": "fuel poverty", "limit": 3}), ("search_grants", {"theme": "community energy", "year_from": 2020, "limit": 3}), ("get_funder_summary", {"funder": "Nesta"}), ("get_recipient", {"name_or_id": "GB-CHC-1135192", "limit": 2}), ("get_recipient", {"name_or_id": "Age"}), ] for name, args in calls: res = await session.call_tool(name, args) text = res.content[0].text print(f"\n== {name} {args} ({len(text)} chars)\n{text[:700]}")
